2011.question: Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions given below in your own words:
2011.prashna: निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर अपने शब्दों में दें:
2011.context:
Celebrated as the party destination in India. Goa appears to have lost its 'happening' tag to the humble Bihar. Data collected by the Union Tourism Ministry appear to indicate that Bihar attracted as a larger number of foreign tourists in 2009 than Goa.
The Government's India Tourism Statistics report shows that while 4.2 lakh foreign tourists visited Bihar in 2009. Goa drew about 3.7 lakh losing its place in the top 10 destinations in India. Industry hands say that the economic downturn was largely responsible for the sharp decline in the number of tourists. Increasing number of adverse reports on the safely of women and declining law and order situation may also have been responsible for the crop in numbers. In fact states like Kerala and Rajasthan that have been hot international favourites have suffered the most in 2009 thanks to the global economic situation. While the number of foreign tourist arrivals dropped by 27% in Rajasthan form 14.7 lakh in 2009 to 10.7 lakh in 2008. Kerala saw 5.4 lakh tourists arriving in 2009. Andhra, that remains numero unto for domestic tourists, also witnessed stagnation with tourist arrivals increasing from 7.8 lakh to just 7.9 lakh between 2008 and 2009.

sub_questions.1: (i) Why is Bihar now. attractive place for the tourists?
sub_questions.2: (ii) Name the states that have suffered the most in 2009.
sub_questions.3: (iii) What is the position of Andhra for tourist arrivals?

anuprashna.1: (i) बिहार अब पर्यटकों के लिए आकर्षक स्थान क्यों है?
anuprashna.2: (ii) उन राज्यों के नाम बताइए जिन्हें 2009 में सबसे अधिक नुकसान हुआ है।
anuprashna.3: (iii) पर्यटकों के आगमन के मामले में आंध्र की स्थिति क्या है?
anuprashna.4: (iv) कौन सा राज्य नुकसान में है?

2012.question: Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follows :
2012.prashna: नीचे दिए गए गद्यांश को पढ़ें और उसके बाद आने वाले प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें:
2012.context: Nothing worthwhile in life. Discipline is a very important condition of progress, stability and strength. Discipline is necessary in every walk of human life. Without discipline there will be disorder and lawlessness. In a civilized society we cannot live without having some regard for the welfare of others. Respect for authority is the basis of discipline. Children must obey their parents. In schools and colleges there must be discipline. Otherwise education will suffer. We find evidence of discipline all around us, even in the world of nature and the world of animals. Discipline costs nothing but it wins a lot. Discipline helps us to safeguard our interests and restrains us from misusing our liberty.

sub_questions.2: What will be the condition of the world if there is no discipline?

sub_questions.5: Find a word in the passage which means 'evidence'.
sub_questions.6: Without discipline one cannot achieve anything. Explain.

anuprashna.2: यदि अनुशासन न हो तो विश्व की स्थिति क्या होगी?
anuprashna.3: समाज को अपने नागरिकों में अनुशासन पैदा करना कहाँ से शुरू करना चाहिए?
anuprashna.4: अनुशासित समाज के लिए दो महत्वपूर्ण बातों का उल्लेख करें।
anuprashna.5: गद्यांश में वह शब्द खोजें जिसका अर्थ 'साक्ष्य' (evidence) है।
anuprashna.6: बिना अनुशासन के कोई भी कुछ हासिल नहीं कर सकता। व्याख्या करें।

2014.question: Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions given below in your own words:
2014.prashna: निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर अपने शब्दों में दें:
2014.context: If you wish to be a writer, you must learn to develop your own point of view. All good writers make us see things in a different light. You may be writing about the same thing as your classmate, but your presentation must reflect your personality and individuality. There are so many interesting subjects you can write about in different forms but here we will try to attempt writing short stories. There is a good market for the following types: The humorous stories, the adventurous stories, the domestic stories, the mysteries and stories related to animals and strange experiences. Don't worry if the story turns out to be very short. Some of the very good stories are quite very short. Be very careful about the end of the story. So think of a plot-make points on how the story will progress and pen it down.

sub_questions.1: What does a reader do to be a writer?
sub_questions.2: What things must a successful writer keep in mind while writing a story?
sub_questions.3: Write any two types of stories which people like to read.
sub_questions.4: Find a phrase in the passage which means the same ‘to write’.

anuprashna.4: गद्यांश में वह वाक्यांश ढूँढ़िए जिसका अर्थ 'लिखना' (to write) के समान हो।
